punchline: A Brazilian professor looked at how food is made, not only at its label.
thirty_sec: Around 2009 Carlos Monteiro of the University of São Paulo coined "ultra-processed" and proposed NOVA, four food groups by degree of processing. Brazil's 2014 dietary guidelines, which he coordinated, advise avoiding ultra-processed products.
question: Which product that came into your home this week could you never make in your own kitchen?
key_contrast: A classification by how food is made, with ingredients second.
